summary: Resolved Inspector's portability blocker by moving the stale SP_CORE INI compatibility shim into tracked orbit config construction and making the unit test use an explicit temporary user config fixture instead of ignored examples/flashlight/user_config.yaml. Root cause: the previous test only passed when a local ignored user_config.yaml happened to contain the legacy *_INI_CONFIG_VALUES maps.
work_completed: Read the Inspector and prior Builder ResultPackets.

Added tracked compatibility behavior in examples/flashlight/run_orbit_collection.py: build_config now ensures missing legacy SP_CORE *_INI_CONFIG_VALUES keys are present as empty CfgNode maps after loading config, while preserving any user-provided legacy maps.
Extended build_config with an optional user_config_files parameter so tests can exercise config merge behavior without the ignored local examples/flashlight/user_config.yaml.

Updated tests/test_orbit_collection_validation.py so the compatibility test writes a temporary user_config.yaml containing only the current SP_CORE INI schema, then verifies the current schema, injected legacy schema, and dumped config all survive.
Ran requested validation: python -m unittest tests/test_orbit_collection_validation.py, 14 tests passed.
Ran a focused smoke check with user_config_files=[] confirming the tracked build_config path injects all legacy keys without using local ignored config.

findings.message: Portability blocker is fixed: the compatibility test no longer reads examples/flashlight/user_config.yaml and instead uses a temporary fixture under tempfile.TemporaryDirectory.

Runtime compatibility is preserved in tracked source: build_config injects empty legacy SP_CORE EDITOR/ENGINE/GAME/GAME_USER_SETTINGS/INPUT *_INI_CONFIG_VALUES maps for stale standalone binaries that still query those keys.
Validation passed: py_compile completed successfully and the orbit validation unittest suite ran 14 tests successfully.

follow_up_recommendations: Inspector should re-review the portability fix and compatibility shim.
Rebuild the standalone SpearSim binary from the rebased source when practical so it uses the current upstream CONFIG_*_INI_STRING schema directly.
memory_worthy: SP_CORE stale-binary compatibility is now injected in tracked examples/flashlight/run_orbit_collection.py instead of relying on ignored examples/flashlight/user_config.yaml.
